channel.title: Brazil Elections 2026
channel.description: Real-time monitoring of the 2026 Brazilian presidential elections.

item.title: INSS: PF aciona AGU sobre decisão de André Mendonça contra Lulinha
item.description: The Federal Police has appealed to the AGU to overturn rulings by Supreme Court Minister André Mendonça in Operation Sem Desconto, which investiges a billion-dollar fraud scheme at INSS. Mendonça’s rulings require all investigative acts to be filed in his cabinet and any police removals to be pre-notified to the STF. The operation has indicted 48 people, including Lulinha, Lula’s eldest son, alleged to be a hidden partner of 'Careca do INSS'.

item.title: Missões de observação eleitoral vão acompanhar todas as etapas das Eleições 2026
item.description: Electoral Observation Missions (MOEs) will return for the 2026 General Elections, operating independently and accredited by the TSE to monitor all stages of the electoral process, from preparation and voting to vote counting, totalization, and electronic voting system audits. Composed of national and international organizations, these missions aim to enhance transparency, strengthen public trust, and produce independent reports to improve Brazil’s electoral system.

item.title: ‘Eu não sou sabor direita, sou direita raiz’, diz Caiado
item.description: Ronaldo Caiado (PSD) declares himself 'rooted right-wing' and rejects centrist positioning, aiming to attract Bolsonaro voters to face Lula in a 2026 runoff. His candidacy, with Gilberto Kassab as running mate, signals a clear rightward shift despite PSD’s attempts to remain centrist. Caiado prioritizes defeating the PT and would support any right-wing candidate if he fails to reach the second round.

item.title: TikTok anuncia plano contra desinformação eleitoral
item.description: TikTok announced a plan to counter electoral misinformation for the 2026 elections, hours after the TSE ruled that social media platforms with over 5 million monthly active users must submit compliance plans. The initiative aims to reduce the spread of false content during the electoral period.

item.title: PF pede ao STF nova investigação de Lulinha e cita acesso ao gabinete presidencial
item.description: The Federal Police requested the STF to open a new investigation against Fábio Luís Lula da Silva (Lulinha), son of President Lula, for alleged influence peddling and corruption in the medicinal cannabis trade. The PF claims Lulinha worked with entrepreneur Roberta Luchsinger and lobbyist Antônio Camilo Antunes ('Careca do INSS') to secure contracts with the Ministry of Health, allegedly using presidential palace access. Despite case redistribution, the inquiry was reassigned to Minister André Mendonça.

item.title: PF pede ao STF para investigar Lulinha por tráfico de influência
item.description: The Federal Police requested STF authorization to investigate Fábio Luís Lula da Silva (Lulinha), son of President Lula, for alleged influence peddling and corruption in dealings with lobbyist Antonio Carlos Camilo Antunes (Careca do INSS) to favor the approval of medicinal cannabidiol in government programs. The case is now under the rapporteurship of Minister André Mendonça, following distribution on Wednesday (Jul 29), and includes scrutiny of payments from the lobbyist to Roberta Luchsinger’s company and potential transfers to public officials.

item.title: Novo marqueteiro de Flávio Bolsonaro disse há dois meses que não voltaria mais para campanhas
item.description: Duda Lima, recently announced as the new campaign strategist for Flávio Bolsonaro’s presidential bid, had stated just over two months ago that he would not return to political campaigns. His appointment marks a reversal of his prior position, raising questions about consistency. The full article is available only to subscribers.

item.title: Atlético-MG oficializa a contratação de Thiago Borbas, ex-Bragantino
item.description: Atlético-MG officially announced the loan signing until the end of 2026, with a purchase option, of Uruguayan forward Thiago Borbas, who was at Real Oviedo (Spain) and belongs to Bragantino. Borbas, 24, was developed by River Plate (Uruguay) and played for Bragantino, scoring 27 goals in 134 appearances. This signing brings Atlético-MG to the maximum limit of nine foreign players allowed in a Brazilian Serie A match.

item.title: Aliados de Tereza Cristina dizem que ela aceita ser vice de Flávio e vai tentar reverter decisão de neutralidade da federação União-PP
item.description: Senator Tereza Cristina (PP-MS) signaled willingness to be Flávio Bolsonaro’s (PL-RJ) vice-presidential running mate after initially denying interest. However, the União-PP federation maintains presidential neutrality, though consultations with PP state directories are underway for a possible reversal by August 5. The move is seen as PL pressure, with little expectation of internal PP shift except in a last-minute negotiation scenario.

item.title: Crises e pressão interna derrubaram marqueteiros de Flávio Bolsonaro
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro replaced marketers Alexandre Oltramari and Eduardo Fischer after internal PL pressure due to poor polling, political crises, and the team’s resistance to integrating Bolsonaro family allies and maintaining dialogue with national leadership. The change, made by mutual agreement, paved the way for Duda Lima — who led Jair Bolsonaro’s 2022 campaign — to take over, despite having previously stated he would not work on 2026 elections.

item.title: Entenda como foi a Guerra do Paraguai citada por Lula
item.description: The Paraguayan War (1864-1870) was the largest and bloodiest armed conflict in South American history, pitting Paraguay against the alliance of Brazil, Argentina, and Uruguay. It resurfaced in public discourse after being cited by President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva on July 24, 2026, sparking diplomatic tension with Paraguay. The war caused the death of over half of Paraguay’s population, mostly men, and resulted in the loss of approximately 40% of its national territory.

item.title: Tereza Cristina avisa a aliados que aceitou ser vice de Flávio; definição depende do aval do PP
item.description: Senator Tereza Cristina (PP-MS) told allies she has accepted to run as vice president on Senator Flávio Bolsonaro’s (PL-RJ) 2026 presidential ticket. The formal confirmation still requires approval from the Progressive Party (PP), which is part of a federation with União Brasil. The final ticket definition is pending internal PP review.

item.title: Saída de marqueteiros da campanha de Flávio partiu deles
item.description: Journalist Alexandre Oltramari and publicist Eduardo Fisher voluntarily left Flávio Bolsonaro's campaign after expressing dissatisfaction with not being consulted on strategic decisions. Despite maintaining a good relationship with the candidate, they claimed a lack of autonomy in shaping the campaign's marketing strategy. The campaign announced their departure without mentioning their resignation request and confirmed Duda Lima as the new marketing lead.

item.title: Omar Aziz declara R$ 2,07 milhões para disputar o governo do AM
item.description: Senator Omar Aziz, the PSD candidate for governor of Amazonas in 2026, declared R$2.07 million in assets to the TSE, an increase of R$1.08 million from the R$990,100 reported in his previous candidacy. The disclosure was made as part of the 2026 general elections registration. The information was originally published by O Antagonista.

item.title: Juristas e políticos argentinos criticam decreto de Milei e citam o Brasil
item.description: Argentine jurists and politicians criticized President Javier Milei's Decree of Necessity and Urgency, which expands migration restrictions and allows expulsion of foreigners for statements deemed 'hate speech' against Argentines. They highlighted the irony that Milei, due to his public criticism of Brazilian President Lula, could be barred from entering Brazil or Spain if those countries adopted similar measures. The decree also covers acts against national symbols and will be reviewed by Argentina's Congress within 10 business days.

item.title: TikTok apresenta medidas para combate à desinformação durante eleições depois de exigência do TSE
item.description: TikTok announced new measures to combat misinformation during the 2026 elections following a TSE requirement, including partnerships with MonitorA and Agência Lupa for educational videos, improved AI models for violation detection, Trust and Safety structural adjustments, and an Elections Hub with voting guidance and reporting tools. The platform reported 99.8% of misinformation removals were proactive in Q1, and 99.3% of electoral integrity violations were removed before any user report.

item.title: Com empurrão de Tarcísio, Tereza Cristina pode aceitar ser vice de Flávio Bolsonaro
item.description: São Paulo Governor Tarcísio de Freitas brokered an alliance between the Progressistas and Flávio Bolsonaro's PL, convincing Senator Tereza Cristina to accept the vice-presidential candidacy, conditional on the party joining a federation with União Brasil. The move followed unsuccessful attempts by Michel Temer to persuade her. The 2026 election between Lula and Flávio Bolsonaro will be decided by undecided voters.

item.title: Augusto Cury sugere chapa única com Zema
item.description: Augusto Cury, pre-candidate for president from the Avante party, stated he called Minas Gerais Governor Romeu Zema (Novo) to propose a single presidential ticket for the 2026 election. In an open letter, Cury said he discussed the possibility of an alliance in the first round, aiming to unite forces against the current political landscape.

item.title: PSD anuncia ex-ministro Aldo Rebelo como coordenador político de campanha de Caiado
item.description: The PSD announced that former minister Aldo Rebelo will serve as the political coordinator for Ronaldo Caiado's presidential campaign in the 2026 elections. The appointment strengthens the party's strategy of leveraging experienced political figures to bolster the ticket. The news was released on Thursday, June 30, at 5:34 PM.

item.title: PT diz que Flávio amplifica rede de perfis anônimos que atacam Lula com IA, e aciona TSE
item.description: The PT filed a complaint with the TSE against Flávio Bolsonaro, alleging he amplified a network of anonymous profiles using AI to attack Lula with coordinated offensive content. The complaint cites 31 profiles with over 1.4 million followers and seeks accountability and individual fines for publications.

item.title: Depois de impasse com DC, Aldo Rebelo vai para campanha de Ronaldo Caiado
item.description: Former minister Aldo Rebelo, following a deadlock with the DC party over his presidential bid, announced he will join Ronaldo Caiado's (PSD) campaign as coordinator. Rebelo, who served in the governments of Dilma Rousseff and Lula, had sought to run for president under the DC but was passed over in favor of former STF minister Joaquim Barbosa, whose candidacy remains unresolved after a legal dispute. Rebelo's decision comes after he spoke at Caiado's convention, where he endorsed a national development project.

item.title: Campanha de Flávio dissocia troca no marketing de polêmicas em convenção
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro's (PL) campaign states the marketing team change, announced on Thursday, is being dissociated from the controversies that occurred at the presidenciável's convention last weekend.

item.title: Aldo Rebelo assume coordenação política da campanha de Caiado
item.description: Aldo Rebelo, former minister and former president of the Chamber of Deputados, assumed the political coordination of Ronaldo Caiado's 2026 presidential campaign. His appointment follows his controversial expulsion from the DC party, for which he was a pre-candidate, and reflects Caiado's strategy to broaden dialogue across societal sectors. Rebelo had previously spoken at the PSD national convention that formalized Caiado's candidacy, advocating for a national project centered on development, sovereignty, and state planning capacity.

item.title: Dependente do Brasil, Paraguai faz jogo de cena com convocação de embaixador
item.description: Paraguay summoned Brazil's ambassador in Asunción for explanations after President Lulu's comment likening the Paraguayan War to modern defense needs, which was seen as insensitive given the historical trauma. While Lula was factually correct about Solano López's invasion initiating the conflict, Paraguay views the remark as offensive, particularly amid its political alignment with Javier Milei and the Bolsonaro clan. Despite the diplomatic spat, Paraguay remains economically dependent on Brazil, especially in trade and energy from Itaipu Dam.

item.title: Fogo amigo, crise com Michelle e erros na comunicação: por que Flávio trocou novamente o comando da campanha
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro's campaign replaced its communications leadership again, appointing Duda Lima over Alexandre Oltramari and Eduardo Fischer amid weeks of internal and external criticism. The change followed failures to respond swiftly to crises, such as Michelle Bolsonaro's critical video, and a perception that the team was consistently reactive rather than proactive. PL leaders acknowledged that critiques from Bolsonarist allies, including Fabio Wajngarten and Paulo Figueiredo, had gained traction within the party.

item.title: Planalto evita disputa histórica com Paraguai e aposta em diplomacia
item.description: The Lula administration chose not to publicly respond to Paraguayan criticism over his reference to Paraguay’s invasion of Brazil during the War of the Triple Alliance, opting instead for diplomatic engagement to preserve bilateral relations. Officials assess that while the topic is sensitive in Paraguay, it should not escalate to undermine cooperation, with Lula potentially reaffirming his affection for the Paraguayan people in any future public remarks.

item.title: Tabata brinca sobre foto de João Campos com Lula: “Namorado dele”
item.description: Deputy Tabata Amaral made a joking post comparing her husband João Campos’ meeting with President Lula to a 'boyfriend meeting his boyfriend'. The encounter took place during the PSB National Convention in Brasília, where Lula reaffirmed his public support for Campos’ gubernatorial campaign in Pernambuco.

item.title: O que Lula falou sobre o Paraguai, e quem está certo sobre a história?
item.description: Lula made remarks about the War of the Triple Alliance (1864-1870) that Paraguay considered offensive, prompting the summoning of Brazil's ambassador in Asunción for explanations. Paraguay viewed the comments as a historical distortion and lack of respect, while Lula's defenders say he was attempting to contextualize past regional conflicts. The episode revived historical tensions between the two nations.

item.title: Aldo Rebelo é escolhido como coordenador da campanha de Caiado
item.description: The campaign of Ronaldo Caiado (PSD) announced on Thursday (July 30) that former minister Aldo Rebelo will serve as coordinator of his presidential bid. Rebelo, a former federal deputy and minister in the Lula and Dilma governments, will oversee the campaign's political articulation following a meeting with PSD leadership in São Paulo.

item.title: Renan Santos é candidato que mais impulsiona anúncios contra Lula e Flávio Bolsonaro nas redes
item.description: Renan Santos, the candidate from the Missão party, spent the most on targeted ads against President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva and Senator Flávio Bolsonaro on social media, among those positioning themselves as a third way in the 2026 presidential race. His focus on direct attacks against these two figures reflects a strategy of ideological contrast to gain visibility.

item.title: PT aciona TSE contra IAs ligadas à família Bolsonaro
item.description: The Brazil of Hope Federation filed a representation with the TSE against a network of anonymous Instagram profiles using AI to produce offensive content against President Lula, with coordinated sharing by Flávio Bolsonaro and PL congressmen. The scheme involves over 30 profiles replicating AI-generated videos, including one depicting Lula holding a bag of money and wearing a shirt provocative toward Trump, reaching over 10 million people and generating profit through AI course sales and cryptocurrency donations.

item.title: Caiado minimiza falta de Tarcísio em convenção do PSD: "Independência"
item.description: Ronaldo Caiado downplayed the absence of Governor Tarcísio de Freitas at the PSD convention, emphasizing Tarcísio's independence and affirming that the PSD's support for his candidacy is clear, with a campaign structure already in place. He noted that Tarcísio's support for Flávio Bolsonaro is not unprecedented in Brazilian politics and maintained a good personal relationship with the governor. The 'pure-blood' Caiado-Kassab ticket aims to position itself as a third way between Lula and Flávio Bolsonaro.

item.title: Paraguai convoca embaixador do Brasil após fala de Lula sobre guerra
item.description: Paraguay summoned Brazil's ambassador in Asunción for explanations following President Lula's remarks about the Paraguayan War. Foreign Minister Rubén Ramírez Lezcano announced the move, indicating that Lula and Paraguayan President Santiago Peña will engage in dialogue on the matter.

item.title: Campanha de Flávio Bolsonaro troca de novo comando da comunicação e anuncia Duda Lima
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro's (PL) campaign announced a new change in its communications structure, replacing the previous leadership with Duda Lima. The adjustment was confirmed by campaign general coordinator Senator Rogério Marinho (PL-RN) in a statement released on Thursday, the 30th.

item.title: Caiado diz que Flávio teria dificuldades para vencer no segundo turno
item.description: PSD presidential pre-candidate Ronaldo Caiado stated that Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL-RJ) would face difficulties winning a potential runoff in the 2026 elections. He emphasized his administrative experience as a competitive advantage. The comment was made during a press conference in São Paulo.

item.title: É #FAKE que Moraes disse que 'nem Trump' poderá visitar Bolsonaro
item.description: It is #FAKE that Minister Alexandre de Moraes said 'not even Trump' could visit Bolsonaro. The video circulating on social media, featuring AI-generated narration, falsely attributes statements to the STF minister claiming Trump, Milei, or others cannot meet Bolsonaro, and that Bolsonaro is ready to return to Papudinha with doubled security. The STF's press office denied the allegations, stating no such statements were made.

item.title: Flávio troca marqueteiros e convida Duda Lima para assumir campanha
item.description: Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL-RJ) has invited political marketer Duda Lima to lead the communications team for his 2026 presidential campaign. Lima, with over 20 years of experience, previously managed Bolsonaro’s 2022 campaign and Ricardo Nunes’ victorious São Paulo mayoral race. The shift follows the departure of Alexandre Oltramari and Eduardo Fischer, whose contributions were praised by the campaign.

item.title: Kassio vai relatar ação do PT sobre IA para desinformação contra Lula
item.description: TSE Minister Kassio Nunes Marques has been assigned as rapporteur in a case filed by the PT, PV, and PCdoB coalition, accusing PL politicians — including Senator Flávio Bolsonaro and deputies Mario Frias, Gustavo Gayer, Gilvan da Federal, and pre-candidate André Marinho — of using AI and anonymous profiles on Instagram and TikTok to spread disinformation against Lula. The complaint alleges coordinated inauthentic behavior (astroturfing) via Instagram’s 'collab' feature, offensive jingles on TikTok, and the amplification of synthetic content to reach over 10 million people.

item.title: Veja as diferenças de Lula e Flávio nas pesquisas estaduais de Rio, SP, MG e mais 7 estados
item.description: The Quaest polls across ten Brazilian states show Lula leading in Minas Gerais, Pernambuco, Bahia, Ceará, Pará, and São Paulo (though narrowly), while Flávio Bolsonaro leads in São Paulo, Rio de Janeiro, Paraná, Rio Grande do Sul, and Goiás. Lula’s largest leads are in Pernambuco and Ceará (34 and 37 points), while Flávio’s strongest advantage is in Paraná (18 points). The data reflects a polarized race with significant regional variation.

item.title: Transparência Internacional lança agenda com 40 propostas de combate à corrupção para Estados
item.description: Transparency International-Brazil launched an agenda with 40 anti-corruption proposals for state governments, effective 2027–2030. The recommendations span seven thematic axes, including open data, anti-corruption mechanisms, parliamentary amendments, public works, internal control agencies, social participation, and public security, highlighting state portals for tracking obras and emendas, whistleblower protection, and the creation of State Transparency and Anti-Corruption Councils.

item.title: Flávio Bolsonaro troca de marqueteiro pela segunda vez em dois meses
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro, the PL's presidential candidate, has changed campaign managers for the second time in two months, replacing Eduardo Fischer with Duda Lima — the same strategist who led Jair Bolsonaro's defeated 2022 campaign. The move reflects growing turmoil in his bid, plagued by the Master case, a feud with his stepmother, ties to Trump's tariff policies, lack of a running mate, and failure to secure Centrão party support.

item.title: Flávio troca equipe e contrata marqueteiro da campanha de Bolsonaro em 2022
item.description: Duda Lima, the strategist behind Jair Bolsonaro's 2022 reelection campaign, has been hired to lead Flávio Bolsonaro's (PL-RJ) presidential bid for 2026. The news is exclusive and requires a subscription for full access.

item.title: Campanha de Flávio troca marqueteiro pela segunda vez após crises: Duda Lima assume posto
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro's campaign replaced its communications team for the second time in two months, dismissing Alexandre Oltramari and Eduardo Fischer and hiring Duda Lima, who led Jair Bolsonaro's 2022 campaign and is allied with PL president Valdemar Costa Neto. The move was announced by campaign coordinator Senator Rogério Marinho following criticism over the team's slow response to crises involving Michelle Bolsonaro and the 'Dark Horse' scandal.

item.title: Campanha de Flávio Bolsonaro troca comando da comunicação pela 2ª vez e anuncia Duda Lima como marqueteiro
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro's (PL) campaign announced its second change in communications leadership, replacing Alexandre Oltramari and Eduardo Fischer with Duda Lima, a publicist linked to Valdemar Costa Neto and former strategist for Jair Bolsonaro's 2022 campaign and Ricardo Nunes' victorious 2024 São Paulo mayoral bid. The shift follows the party's convention, which featured an AI-generated video simulating the former president, and comes amid recent controversies. Lima, who had declared retirement from campaign work in 2024, returns despite previously stating he would no longer sign on to campaigns.

item.title: Kataguiri troca farpas com Eduardo Bolsonaro: “Frouxo”
item.description: Federal deputy Kim Kataguiri (Missão-SP) responded to threats from Eduardo Bolsonaro (PL-SP), who said he would return to Brazil to 'beat up' the lawmaker, following Kataguiri's comments in a podcast. Kataguiri labeled Bolsonaro as 'weak' in retaliation, escalating the conflict between the two opposing politicians.

item.title: Flávio troca marketing da campanha e convoca Duda Lima
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro's presidential campaign announced a change in its marketing leadership on Thursday, with the departure of publicists Alexandre Oltramari and Eduardo Fisher and the hiring of Duda Lima, who previously worked on Ricardo Nunes' victorious 2024 campaign. The move aims to strengthen the candidate's communication strategy.

item.title: Sem entusiasmo, Lula sinaliza que finalmente vai se reunir com Alcolumbre
item.description: President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva signaled he will meet with Senate President Davi Alcolumbre (União Brasil) next week, after the parliamentary recess ends. The decision follows renewed appeals for dialogue between the two leaders, although Lula showed little enthusiasm for the meeting. The article is subscriber-only.

item.title: A acusação do governo Lula contra Trump na OMC
item.description: The Lula government accuses the Trump administration of violating WTO commitments by imposing additional tariffs of 25% and 12.5% on Brazilian goods, claiming these measures breach GATT and the WTO dispute settlement mechanism. The tariffs were based on USTR Section 301 investigations that labeled Brazilian practices in digital trade, intellectual property, ethanol, and forced labor as 'unfair' or 'discriminatory'. Brazil has formally requested consultations at the WTO to challenge these unilateral U.S. actions.

item.title: Tarcísio vai encontrar uma vice para Flávio?
item.description: São Paulo Governor Tarcísio de Freitas (Republicanos) is coordinating Flávio Bolsonaro’s (PL) campaign in the state and working to define a presidential ticket with former President Jair Bolsonaro. He contacted PP national president Ciro Nogueira to secure Senator Tereza Cristina (PP-MS) as the vice-presidential candidate, aiming to strengthen the alliance between parties.

item.title: 'Motoboy do Lula' aciona Ministério Público do Trabalho contra práticas da Keeta
item.description: Junior Freitas, a delivery worker and pre-candidate for state deputy in São Paulo from PSOL, known as 'Lula's delivery guy', filed a complaint with the Labor Public Ministry against practices by the company Keeta. He is a leader of the Movement of Workers Without Rights and participated in the federal working group to regulate delivery workers, as well as attended the launch of the MOVE Brasil credit program alongside President Lula.
